dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: You need a break already? Your travels sure have made you soft.

dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: Can't we just go and get this over with? We're not fighting a trained army here. We'll run circles around those morons.

dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: ...Alright, suit yourself. Just don't keep me waiting too long.

dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: The novelty of these little scuffles quickly wore off for me — now it's just tedious. It amazes me that some people enjoy it so much.

dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: Keep up if you want my help. I don't want to be stuck here all day.

dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: What are you making that face for? I thought you knew my deal by now.

dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: ...*sigh*. Fine. You can talk, and I'll sit over there and listen. Happy now?
